hero.title: Bring us the brief.
hero.description: Share what the site needs to achieve. We’ll use the information to begin a focused conversation around structure, use, delivery, and next steps.

items.title: Project type
items.detail: Warehouse, commercial, hospitality, industrial, convention, or another building need.

items.title: Site & location
items.detail: Where the project is proposed, and any known site conditions or access considerations.

items.title: Scale & timeline
items.detail: Indicative footprint, height, span, programme, and your preferred project timeline.

form.title: Tell us about the space.
form.description: The more context you can share, the more useful the first conversation can be.

aside.title: A clear starting point.
aside.description: We respond to each brief with the project context in view. Your enquiry will be directed to the AA Spaces team for review.
